recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片裡白血球明顯增加，大多是小到中型、胞質嗜鹼性的淋巴樣細胞，好幾顆細胞邊緣有胞質突起（cytoplasmic blebs），這是 T 細胞前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）常見的外觀。
features: Marked lymphocytosis of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with relatively condensed chromatin at this magnification
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm, several cells with cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions
Nucleoli not resolvable at this low power; red cells unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm; several cells display cytoplasmic blebs. Scattered smudged cells are present. Nucleolar detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the appropriate context, findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, to be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD4/CD7-positive T cells) and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement studies.

ddx.dx: B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: B-cell cases have larger cells with a single prominent central nucleolus and no cytoplasmic blebs, and flow shows B-cell markers rather than CD3/CD7.
ATLL cells have deeply lobated 'flower' nuclei, and the patient is HTLV-1 positive with CD25-bright, CD7-negative T cells.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei and are typically CD7-negative/CD26-negative without TCL1A rearrangement.
